text: 中共中央政治局委员、国务院副总理何立峰9日下午在京会见欧盟委员会贸易和经济安全委员谢夫乔维奇，双方就中欧经贸关系交换了意见。 何立峰表示，中方始终高度重视发展同欧盟经贸关系，愿与欧方共同落实好双方领导人达成的重要共识。双方应充分发挥中欧贸易投资磋商机制作用，坚持稳定、平衡的中欧关键贸易伙伴关系新定位，持续对话，妥处分歧，推动双边经贸关系健康稳定发展。 谢夫乔维奇表示，中国是欧盟重要经贸合作伙伴，愿持续推进贸易投资磋商，加强沟通、共促合作。（新华社）
text_en: On the afternoon of the 9th in Beijing, He Lifeng, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Vice Premier of the State Council, met with Maroš Šefčovič, European Commissioner for Trade and Economic Security, and the two sides exchanged views on China-EU economic and trade relations. He Lifeng said China has always attached great importance to developing economic and trade relations with the EU and is willing to work with the EU to implement the important consensus reached by the leaders of both sides. The two sides should give full play to the role of the China-EU trade and investment consultation mechanism, adhere to the new positioning of a stable and balanced key trade partnership between China and the EU, maintain continued dialogue, properly handle differences, and promote the sound and stable development of bilateral economic and trade relations. Šefčovič said China is an important economic and trade cooperation partner of the EU, and the EU is willing to continue advancing trade and investment consultations, strengthen communication and jointly promote cooperation. (Xinhua)
